title: Sweet Breeze Canal Boat Tours
specs: Authentic 1840s canal boat replica, scaled to 3/4 size
Cruises on three rivers: St. Mary’s, St. Joe, and Maumee
Fully accessible boat with removable chairs and loading ramp
Boat is wheelchair accessible; notify in advance if multiple power chairs or wheelchairs in group
Private rentals available; contact by phone or email
includes: Light refreshments on River Ecology Trivia cruise
blurb: Guests board the Sweet Breeze, a replica canal boat, for guided tours on the St. Mary’s, St. Joe, and Maumee rivers in Fort Wayne, Indiana. Tours last 45, 60, or 90 minutes and provide opportunities to learn about local history, wildlife, and ecology. The boat is fully accessible and accommodates up to 38 riders.
extraNote: Add $5 for tickets purchased dockside · Gift cards can be used to purchase tickets but not for other items · Sweet Breeze dock at Promenade Park, Fort Wayne, Indiana
